name: Workspace Names
author: Fred Nix & Larry
description: Give Hyprland workspaces a title without touching their numbers. Workspaces name themselves from their windows until you rename them. Includes inline rename and a live Workspace Map with occupancy and app identities. Names live in ~/.config/omarchy/workspace-names.json.

barWidget.description: Workspace numbers with inline renaming; names flash in a centered screen popup.
